---
title: "Hypothesis 1 - Mother-daughter associations"
metadata-files:
  - _quarto.yml
---

# Overview

This script addresses **Hypothesis 1**: do mother–daughter pairs show stronger associations than other pair types during the daughter's first summer ?
and ** Hypothesis 2**, how do associations change when colony size is different, does each pair react differently?

Three pair types are compared throughout:

- mother-daughter (MD)

- mother paired with an unrelated juvenile female

- juveniles together

- all remaining female dyads ("other")

The analysis has two stages:

1.  **QAP** (year-specific): tests whether MD dyads are more strongly associated expected by chance, within each year separately.
2.  **GLMM** (cross-year): estimates the overall effect of pair type (4 types) on association strength across all eleven years, and tests whether this effect is modulated by colony size.

Both colonies (GB2 and UA) are analysed in parallel using identical pipelines.Update: final model for H1 was a merged model with two colonies together

# 2  QAP analysis (year-specific)
Tests whether MD pairs are more strongly associated than all other dyads within each year. This is a binary comparison (MD vs. non-MD)

## 2.1 List of Networks
```{r}

#----- create list of all the networks for each years

net_list_GB2 <- list(
  # 2016 removed: only one mother-daughter pair in the network
  "2013" = net_G2013,"2014" = net_G2014,"2015" = net_G2015,"2017" = net_G2017,"2018" = net_G2018,"2019" = net_G2019,"2020" = net_G2020,"2021" = net_G2021,"2022" = net_G2022,"2023" = net_G2023
)

net_list_UA <- list(
  "2013" = net_U2013,"2014" = net_U2014,"2015" = net_U2015,"2016" = net_U2016,"2017" = net_U2017,"2018" = net_U2018,"2019" = net_U2019,"2020" = net_U2020,"2021" = net_U2021,"2022" = net_U2022,"2023" = net_U2023
)
```

## 2.2 run QAP
```{r qap-run}
QAP_GB2 <- run_qap(net_list_GB2, edges_GB2)
QAP_UA  <- run_qap(net_list_UA,  edges_UA)

#save results
save(QAP_GB2, QAP_UA,file = here("results", "H1_QAP.RData"))
write.csv(QAP_GB2, here("results","tables","H1_QAP_GB2.csv"))
write.csv(QAP_UA, here("results","tables","H1_QAP_UA.csv"))
```

```{r qap-results}
cat("GB2\n"); print(QAP_GB2)
cat("\n UA \n");  print(QAP_UA)
```

# 3  GLMM — cross-year analysis

## 3.1  check for influential years (cook's distance)

Use of lme4 here in order to measure cook's distance (not possible with glmmTMB)

```{r cooks_distance}
# GB2 -----
model_diag_GB2 <- lmer(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data = edges_GB2
)
infl_GB2 <- influence(model_diag_GB2, group = "year")
car::infIndexPlot(infl_GB2, vars = "Cook")
cooks.distance(infl_GB2)

# UA -----
model_diag_UA <- lmer(
  weight ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data = edges_UA
)
infl_UA <- influence(model_diag_UA, group = "year")
car::infIndexPlot(infl_UA, vars = "Cook")
cooks.distance(infl_UA)
```

```{r random_effects}
#check random effects
VarCorr(model_diag_GB2)
VarCorr(model_diag_UA)

#correlation
cor.test(edges_GB2$year,  edges_GB2$colony_size)
cor.test(edges_UA$year,  edges_UA$colony_size)
```

/!\ Colony size and year are highly correlated

## 3.2 Influential years
No year was flagged by the Cook's distance --> all years are kept 
```{r}
edge_GB2_clean <- edges_GB2
edge_UA_clean  <- edges_UA
```

## 3.3 Weight transformation before GLMM 
Beta distribution requires values strictly between 0 and 1. Transformation following: $y' = \frac{(y\times(n-1) + 0.5)}{n}$  (Smithson & Verkuilen, 2006). The original SRI is kept in "weight"

```{r transformation}
#GB2
n <- nrow(edge_GB2_clean)
edge_GB2_clean$weight_beta <- (edge_GB2_clean$weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

#UA
n <- nrow(edge_UA_clean)
edge_UA_clean$weight_beta <- (edge_UA_clean$weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n
```

```{r pairs_categorization}
edge_GB2_clean <- edge_GB2_clean %>%
  mutate(pair_type_2 = factor(pair_type_2,
                              levels = c("other", "daughter-daughter",
                                         "mother-unrelated-juvenile", "mother-daughter")))

edge_UA_clean <- edge_UA_clean %>%
  mutate(pair_type_2 = factor(pair_type_2,
                              levels = c("other", "daughter-daughter",
                                         "mother-unrelated-juvenile", "mother-daughter")))
```


## 3.4 models
Two models per colony: one without interaction (main effects only) and one with a pair type × colony size interaction to test whether the effect of pair type depends on demographic context.

```{r models}
# GB2 -------
model_GB2 <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 + colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edge_GB2_clean,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_GB2_int <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edge_GB2_clean,
  family = beta_family()
)

# UA ------
model_UA <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 + colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edge_UA_clean,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_UA_int <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edge_UA_clean,
  family = beta_family()
)
```

```{r model summaries}
summary(model_GB2);     summary(model_GB2_int)
summary(model_UA);      summary(model_UA_int)
```

## 3.5 H2 sensitivity: year instead of colony size
Colony size and year are correlated (GB2: r = 0.91), so we fit the same interaction models with year instead of colony size and compare them with AIC.

```{r h2-sensitivity}
# centred year
edge_GB2_clean$year_c <- edge_GB2_clean$year - mean(edge_GB2_clean$year)
edge_UA_clean$year_c  <- edge_UA_clean$year  - mean(edge_UA_clean$year)

model_GB2_int_year <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 * year_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edge_GB2_clean,
  family = beta_family()
)

model_UA_int_year <- glmmTMB(
  weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 * year_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edge_UA_clean,
  family = beta_family()
)

# lower AIC = better fit (difference < 2: models fit equally well)
AIC(model_GB2_int, model_GB2_int_year)
AIC(model_UA_int,  model_UA_int_year)

summary(model_GB2_int_year)
summary(model_UA_int_year)
```

## 3.6 merged model (H1)
Update: for H1, merged model, two colonies together with colony ID as fixed factor
```{r}
edge_GB2_clean$colony_ID <- "GB2"
edge_UA_clean$colony_ID <- "UA"

#merged the two datasets
edges_full <- rbind(edge_GB2_clean, edge_UA_clean)

#recenter colony_size for both 
edges_full <- edges_full %>%
  mutate(colony_size_c = as.numeric(
    scale(colony_size, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)
  ))

#recompoute the weight 
n <- nrow(edges_full)
edges_full <- edges_full %>%
  mutate(weight_beta = (weight * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n)

#check corr again
cor.test(edges_full$year,  edges_full$colony_size) #0.7798352 
```


```{r}
model_full <- glmmTMB(
  # colony size not included: it varies only between years (year random effect), and is tested in H2
  weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 + colony_ID + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
  data   = edges_full,
  family = beta_family()
)

summary(model_full)
```

# 4  Permutation (node-label permutations)

For each permutation, pair-type labels are shuffled within year while preserving the number of pairs per type The GLMM is refitted on each permutations, and the coefficients are stored. P values are measured as the proportion of permuted coefficients that are equal or exceeding the observed coefficient

We did n = 1000 permutations for each model

## 4.1  GB2

```{r perm GB2}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
set.seed(23)
n_perm <- 100 # 1000 for the final results

#coefficients 
coef_names_GB2 <- c(
  "pair_type_2daughter-daughter",
  "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile",
  "pair_type_2mother-daughter",
  "colony_size_c"
)

coef_names_GB2_int <- c(
  "pair_type_2daughter-daughter",
  "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile",
  "pair_type_2mother-daughter",
  "colony_size_c",
  "pair_type_2daughter-daughter:colony_size_c",
  "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile:colony_size_c",
  "pair_type_2mother-daughter:colony_size_c"
)

obs_coef_GB2     <- fixef(model_GB2)$cond[coef_names_GB2]
obs_coef_GB2_int <- fixef(model_GB2_int)$cond[coef_names_GB2_int]

perm_GB2     <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(coef_names_GB2),
                       dimnames = list(NULL, coef_names_GB2))
perm_GB2_int <- matrix(NA, n_perm, length(coef_names_GB2_int),
                       dimnames = list(NULL, coef_names_GB2_int))

for (i in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  d <- edge_GB2_clean %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    mutate(pair_type_2 = sample(pair_type_2)) %>%
    ungroup()

  m <- glmmTMB(weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 + colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
               family = beta_family(), data = d)
  perm_GB2[i, ] <- fixef(m)$cond[coef_names_GB2]

  m_int <- glmmTMB(weight_beta ~ pair_type_2 * colony_size_c + (1 | pairID) + (1 | year),
                   family = beta_family(), data = d)
  perm_GB2_int[i, ] <- fixef(m_int)$cond[coef_names_GB2_int]
}

save(perm_GB2, perm_GB2_int,file = here("results", "H1_permutations_GB2.RData"))
```

```{r perm-gb2-pvalues}
p_GB2     <- compute_perm_pvalues(obs_coef_GB2,     perm_GB2)
p_GB2_int <- compute_perm_pvalues(obs_coef_GB2_int, perm_GB2_int)

table_GB2     <- make_perm_table(obs_coef_GB2,     perm_GB2,     p_GB2)
table_GB2_int <- make_perm_table(obs_coef_GB2_int, perm_GB2_int, p_GB2_int)

cat("── GB2 main effects ──\n");  print(table_GB2)
cat("\n── GB2 interaction ──\n"); print(table_GB2_int)

write.csv(table_GB2,
          here("results", "tables", "H1_perm_GB2_main.csv"),     row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(table_GB2_int,
          here("results", "tables", "H1_perm_GB2_interaction.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

#### pair comparison - inference
```{r}
#coeff
obs_coef_UA <- as.numeric(fixef(model_UA)$cond[coef_names_UA])
names(obs_coef_UA) <- coef_names_UA

# load saved permutations
load(here("results", "H1_permutations_UA.RData"))

# define the pairwise contrasts you want
# MD vs JJ, MD vs MUJ, JJ vs MUJ
contrasts_UA <- bind_rows(
  perm_contrast(perm_UA, obs_coef_UA,
                "pair_type_2mother-daughter", "pair_type_2daughter-daughter"),
  perm_contrast(perm_UA, obs_coef_UA,
                "pair_type_2mother-daughter", "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"),
  perm_contrast(perm_UA, obs_coef_UA,
                "pair_type_2daughter-daughter", "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile")
)

contrasts_UA

# for the plot: 
contrasts_UA_plot <- data.frame(
  level1 = c("mother-daughter", "mother-daughter", "juvenile-juvenile"),
  level2 = c("juvenile-juvenile", "mother-unrelated juvenile", "mother-unrelated juvenile"),
  p_value = c(
    contrasts_UA$p_value[contrasts_UA$contrast == "pair_type_2mother-daughter vs pair_type_2daughter-daughter"],
    contrasts_UA$p_value[contrasts_UA$contrast == "pair_type_2mother-daughter vs pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"],
    contrasts_UA$p_value[contrasts_UA$contrast == "pair_type_2daughter-daughter vs pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"]
  )
)

  perm_contrast(perm_merged, obs_coef_merged,
                "pair_type_2mother-daughter", "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"),
  perm_contrast(perm_merged, obs_coef_merged,
                "pair_type_2daughter-daughter", "pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile")
)

contrasts_merged

# for the plot: 
contrasts_merged_plot <- data.frame(
  level1 = c("mother-daughter", "mother-daughter", "juvenile-juvenile"),
  level2 = c("juvenile-juvenile", "mother-unrelated juvenile", "mother-unrelated juvenile"),
  p_value = c(
    contrasts_merged$p_value[contrasts_merged$contrast == "pair_type_2mother-daughter vs pair_type_2daughter-daughter"],
    contrasts_merged$p_value[contrasts_merged$contrast == "pair_type_2mother-daughter vs pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"],
    contrasts_merged$p_value[contrasts_merged$contrast == "pair_type_2daughter-daughter vs pair_type_2mother-unrelated-juvenile"]
  )
)
```

# Networks
net_GB2 <- plot_network_year(edges_GB2, 2023, "Colony GB2")
net_UA  <- plot_network_year(edges_UA,  2023, "Colony UA")

# 5.2 - H2 demographic context
Using ggpredict
```{r model-predictions}

# GB2: centered range = 24-mean to 68-mean
# UA: centered range = 22-mean to 31-mean
mean_cs_GB2 <- mean(edge_GB2_clean$colony_size, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_cs_UA  <- mean(edge_UA_clean$colony_size,  na.rm = TRUE)

pred_GB2 <- ggpredict(model_GB2_int,
                       terms = c(paste0("colony_size_c [",
                                         round(24 - mean_cs_GB2), ":",
                                         round(68 - mean_cs_GB2), " by=1]"),
                                  "pair_type_2"),
                       bias_correction = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(colony_size_c = x, SRI = predicted, pair_type_2 = group,
         lower = conf.low, upper = conf.high) %>%
  mutate(colony_size = colony_size_c + mean_cs_GB2)

pred_UA <- ggpredict(model_UA,
                      terms = c(paste0("colony_size_c [",
                                        round(22 - mean_cs_UA), ":",
                                        round(31 - mean_cs_UA), " by=0.5]"),
                                 "pair_type_2"),
                      bias_correction = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(colony_size_c = x, SRI = predicted, pair_type_2 = group,
         lower = conf.low, upper = conf.high) %>%
  mutate(colony_size = colony_size_c + mean_cs_UA)


level_order   <- c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                    "daughter-daughter", "mother-daughter")

display_labels <- c("other", "mother-unrelated-juvenile",
                     "juvenile-juvenile", "mother-daughter")

pred_GB2$pair_type_2 <- factor(pred_GB2$pair_type_2,
                                levels = level_order,
                                labels = display_labels)

pred_UA$pair_type_2  <- factor(pred_UA$pair_type_2,
                                levels = level_order,
                                labels = display_labels)


p_GB2 <- make_h2_plot(pred_GB2, "Colony GB2", show_y = TRUE)
p_UA  <- make_h2_plot(pred_UA,  "Colony UA",  show_y = FALSE)

combined <- p_GB2 + p_UA +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

combined
ggsave(here("results","figures","h2_predictions.png"), combined, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
```

# 6  Other descriptive statistics

```{r summarise_edges}
summarise_edges(edge_GB2_clean, "GB2")
summarise_edges(edge_UA_clean,  "UA")
```


```{r summary_table}

counts_GB2 <- count_pairs(edge_GB2_clean, "GB2")
counts_UA  <- count_pairs(edge_UA_clean,  "UA")

counts_all <- bind_rows(counts_GB2, counts_UA)

# wide format, one row per year/colony, one col per pair type
counts_wide <- counts_all %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = pair_type_2, values_from = n_dyads, values_fill = 0)

# add colony size per year
colony_size_GB2 <- edge_GB2_clean %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(colony_size = length(unique(c(from, to))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(colony = "GB2")

colony_size_UA <- edge_UA_clean %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(colony_size = length(unique(c(from, to))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(colony = "UA")

colony_sizes <- bind_rows(colony_size_GB2, colony_size_UA)

# join colony size in
summary_table <- counts_wide %>%
  left_join(colony_sizes, by = c("year", "colony")) %>%
  select(colony, year, colony_size, everything())

print(summary_table)

write.csv(summary_table, here("results","tables","summary_table_pairs.csv"))
```

mean_density(net_list_GB2, "GB2")
